name: detectai-workers (${environment})
description: All workers: analytics consumer, cron sweeper, payments consumer. Queues: analytics.usage, payment_events. Sampler traceidratio 0.1 (analytics, payments), always_on (cron). Runbooks: services/workers/docs.

pages.name: Overview
pages.description: Cross-worker health: throughput, errors, latency, broker connectivity, DLQ

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(worker_jobs_processed_total), 1 minute) AS `msgs/min` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service IN ('worker-analytics', 'worker-payments')
FROM Metric SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE worker_job_errors_total > 0) AS `error %` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service IN ('worker-analytics', 'worker-payments')
FROM Metric SELECT sum(worker_dead_lettered_total) AS `dead letters` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}'
FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(worker_retry_total), 1 minute) AS `retries/min` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}'
FROM Metric SELECT min(rabbitmq_connection_status) AS `connected` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service IN ('worker-analytics', 'worker-payments')
FROM Metric SELECT latest(worker_cron_expiry_lag_seconds) AS `lag s` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service = 'worker-cron'
FROM Metric SELECT latest(worker_cron_expired_backlog) AS `backlog` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND service = 'worker-cron'
FROM Metric SELECT max(process_runtime_nodejs_eventloop_lag_ms) AS `loop lag ms` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}'
FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(worker_jobs_processed_total), 1 minute) AS `msgs/min` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' FACET service TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 6
FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(worker_job_errors_total), 1 minute) AS `errors/min` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' FACET service TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 6
FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 50, 95, 99) WHERE service.name LIKE 'worker-%' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(worker_retry_total), 1 minute) AS `retries/min` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 5
FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(worker_dead_lettered_total), 1 minute) AS `dead/min` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 5
FROM Metric SELECT average(rabbitmq_connection_status) AS `rabbitmq` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' FACET service TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 6
FROM Metric SELECT average(redis_connection_status) AS `redis` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' FACET service TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 6
FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(worker_duplicate_events_total), 1 minute) AS `duplicates/min` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' FACET service TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 6
FROM Metric SELECT average(`container.cpu.utilization`) AS `cpu` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND `container.name` LIKE 'worker%' FACET `container.name` TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 6
FROM Metric SELECT average(`container.memory.percent`) AS `mem` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND `container.name` LIKE 'worker%' FACET `container.name` TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 6

FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(worker_job_errors_total), 1 minute) AS `errors/min`, sum(worker_job_errors_total) AS `total` WHERE deployment.environment = '${environment}' FACET service, job_type, error_type LIMIT 25

widgets.title: Messages processed by worker and type
